articles.summary: WPP announced that it has been selected by Nestlé to architect and operate its new end-to-end content operating model across all brands in Greater China. WPP secured the landmark partnership following a highly competitive and multi-agency pitch process.
articles.title: WPP appointed by Nestlé to lead end-to-end content operating model across Greater China

articles.title: WPP launches flagship production hub in East London
